thread:
Maya: OK team — last sync before we lock the May webinar. Need final run-of-show, rehearsal slot, and lead-routing rules by EOD.
Anya: Speakers locked: Sam (bench), Noor (customer), Leo (demo). Greenroom 09:15 PT, stage 09:35 PT. Can we keep total <= 45m?
Sam: Proposed arc: 1) 2m intro, 2) 6m benchmark narrative (problem -> numbers -> recommendation), 3) 10m demo (cost flow + latency flow), 4) 6m customer vignette, 5) 12m live Q&A, 6) 4m CTAs.
Noor: I'll prepare a 90s customer slide with outcome metrics and 2 talking bullets. Uploading draft by 3pm.
Leo: Ops notes: will pre-warm model for 8 minutes and run 3 priming prompts to fill KV cache. Rehearsal endpoint: `https://staging-proxy.redwood-infer/rehearse?model=rw-2026-bench`. Fallback model: `rw-2026-quant`. If p95 > 400ms or error rate > 1.5% switch to fallback.
Leo: Priming prompts (ops):
1) "Summarize this use case in 12 words"
2) "Rewrite into 2 short bullets"
3) "Extract key intents from: <sample text>"
Anya: Rehearsal window: 30-min full run tomorrow 08:00 PT. I'll send invites and slide order. Please upload slides to the shared drive by 6pm tonight.
Ben: Lead routing: HubSpot form will include hidden fields `utm=may_webinar`, `interest=trial|bench|enterprise`, and `cta_variant=A|B`. Rules: `interest=trial` -> tag `priority-demo` + notify #sales; `bench` -> append to Growth csv for benchmark follow-up; `enterprise` or `security_review=yes` -> route to AE queue. Also capture `timezone` for SDR scheduling.
Maya: CTA experiment: Variant A (trial-first) and Variant B (recording-first). Ben, please implement split 50/50 for first 300 signups and add hidden field `cta_variant`.
Ben: On it. Draft copy A: "Request a hands-on trial for your workload — limited seats". Copy B: "Watch the recording + download the benchmark pack". Posting both to the page now.
Sam: For transparency in benchmarks, add a tiny footnote slide listing dataset name and prompt template used. Keeps us honest.
Noor: Agree. Also request we include a one-line note about data handling for customer audience.
Leo: Ops snippet for rapid failover if rehearsal shows instability:
```
# switch traffic to quantized fallback
kubectl set image deployment/rw-bench rw-bench=rw-2026-quant:stable
curl -X POST https://staging-proxy.redwood-infer/route -d '{"model":"rw-2026-quant"}'
```
ops-bot: Calendar invites created and rehearsal scheduled. Automated note: rehearsal start reminder set for 30 minutes prior.
Anya: I'll own rehearsal facilitation. Agenda: 5m mic-checks, 20m run, 5m debrief. Ops please run smoke tests at T-10 before we go live.
Maya: Final asks: slides uploaded by 6pm, HubSpot hidden fields validated, CTA variants live. If all green, we lock at 6:15pm PT. Thanks! :rocket:
